newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss oil imports rise 6.5 pct, value up 29.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss oil imports rise 6.5 pct, value up 29.8 pct.

text.p: Swiss imports of refined oil products rose 6.5 percent to 11.877 million tonnes in 1996, around the average imports during the 1990s, the Mineral Oil Association EV said.
The total value of the imports rose 29.8 percent to 2.89 billion francs as the average value per tonne rose 21.9 percent to 243.5 francs, the association said.
Switzerland bought 57 percent of its oil products from Western Europe, down from 63 percent in 1995. Imports from African countries rose to 40 percent from 33 percent.
Imports from Africa accounted for 89 percent of all crude oil imports to Switzerland, while imports from the European Union account for 99.6 percent of oil-based products.
